definitions: Fill a bag or suitcase with clothes and other possessions in preparation for a trip.
Put something into a container so that it can be stored or transported.
Compress or be compressed into a dense mass.
Arrange items in a compact way.
Carry something, especially a gun, typically as part of one's job or for protection.
examples: I need to pack my suitcase for the holiday.
She packed the books into a box.
The snow packed hard on the ground.
He packed a lot of information into a short report.
The security guard packs a pistol.
